```{r, message=FALSE}

rm(list=ls())
library(data.table)   # fread
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)          # datatable output
library(scales)
library(lme4)
library(MuMIn)
library(plotly)


N_BOOT_REP = 500

# learning_curve_csv = "01_runs/regression_resnet101/2025-11-20_10-59-32/epoch_results.csv"
# total_lines <- R.utils::countLines(learning_curve_csv)
# learning_curve <- fread(learning_curve_csv, nrows = total_lines - 2)

# Read the leave-spiders-out metadata.
metadata <- fread("metadata_leave_out_Araneae.csv")
metadata <- metadata[IS_VALID == TRUE]

# Keep the variables used by your original linear model.
metadata[, cbrDRYMASS_MG := DRYMASS_MG^(1/3)]
metadata[, sqrtAREA_MM := sqrt(AREA_MM2)]

# Check that no spiders are in training or validation.
stopifnot(
  all(metadata[order == "Araneae", SPLIT] == "test")
)

# Select only the spider test images.
spider_test <- copy(metadata[
  SPLIT == "test" & order == "Araneae"
])

# Read the existing CNN predictions, already converted to mg.
cnn <- fread(
  "spider_comparison_20261120_115833_643083/spider_predictions.csv"
)

# Match by image filename rather than assuming the same row order.
stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(spider_test$IMAGE_FILENAME),
  !anyDuplicated(cnn$IMAGE_FILENAME),
  setequal(spider_test$IMAGE_FILENAME, cnn$IMAGE_FILENAME)
)

idx <- match(spider_test$IMAGE_FILENAME, cnn$IMAGE_FILENAME)

stopifnot(
  isTRUE(all.equal(
    spider_test$DRYMASS_MG,
    cnn$DRYMASS_MG[idx],
    check.attributes = FALSE
  ))
)

spider_test[, BF_mass_mg := cnn$BF_CNN_mass_mg[idx]]
spider_test[, log_mass_mg := cnn$log_biomass_CNN_mass_mg[idx]]

cat("Valid training images:", nrow(metadata[SPLIT == "train"]), "\n")
cat("Spider test images:", nrow(spider_test), "\n")

```

## Area-based biomass prediction
```{r, message=FALSE}
area_model <- lm(
  cbrDRYMASS_MG ~ sqrtAREA_MM,
  data = metadata[SPLIT == "train"]
)

summary(area_model)

# Predict only the held-out spider images.
spider_test[, cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED_AREA_LM :=
  as.numeric(predict(area_model, newdata = spider_test))
]

# Convert cube-root predictions to biomass in mg.
spider_test[, linear_mass_mg :=
  cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED_AREA_LM^3
]

# Plot measured versus predicted mass in mg.
lims <- range(
  c(0, spider_test$DRYMASS_MG, spider_test$linear_mass_mg),
  finite = TRUE
)
scale_dataset <- scale_colour_manual(
  values = c(
    "biodiscover-S" = "#D6604D",
    "EntoScan" = "#4393C3"
  ),
  name = "DATASET"
)


ggplot(
  spider_test,
  aes(
    DRYMASS_MG,
    linear_mass_mg,
    shape = DATASET,
    colour = DATASET
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_dataset +
  coord_fixed(xlim = lims, ylim = lims) +
  labs(
    x = "Measured dry biomass (mg)",
    y = "Predicted dry biomass (mg)",
    title = "Area linear model: held-out spiders"
  )


```

```{r}
set.seed(42)
N_BOOT_REP <- 500

prediction_columns <- c(
  "linear_mass_mg",
  "BF_mass_mg",
  "log_mass_mg"
)

model_names <- c(
  "Area linear model",
  "BF CNN",
  "Direct log-biomass CNN"
)

# All metrics are calculated on biomass in mg.
calculate_metrics <- function(observed, predicted) {
  errors <- predicted - observed
  rmse <- sqrt(mean(errors^2))
  total_variation <- sum((observed - mean(observed))^2)

  c(
    R2 = if (total_variation > 0) {
      1 - sum(errors^2) / total_variation
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    MAE_mg = mean(abs(errors)),
    RMSE_mg = rmse,
    CV_RMSE_percent = 100 * rmse / mean(observed)
  )
}

# Check inputs.
stopifnot(
  nrow(spider_test) > 0,
  all(is.finite(spider_test$DRYMASS_MG)),
  all(spider_test$DRYMASS_MG > 0),
  all(is.finite(as.matrix(spider_test[, ..prediction_columns]))),
  !anyNA(spider_test[, .(DATASET, INSECT_ID)])
)

# Original point estimates using every spider test image.
point_results <- rbindlist(
  lapply(seq_along(prediction_columns), function(i) {

    scores <- calculate_metrics(
      spider_test$DRYMASS_MG,
      spider_test[[prediction_columns[i]]]
    )

    data.table(
      MODEL = model_names[i],
      METRIC = names(scores),
      estimate = unname(scores)
    )
  })
)

# Store all image-row numbers belonging to each specimen.
specimen_rows <- split(
  seq_len(nrow(spider_test)),
  list(spider_test$DATASET, spider_test$INSECT_ID),
  drop = TRUE
)

# Paired specimen-cluster bootstrap.
bootstrap_results <- rbindlist(
  lapply(seq_len(N_BOOT_REP), function(rep_id) {

    # Sample specimens with replacement.
    selected_specimens <- sample.int(
      length(specimen_rows),
      length(specimen_rows),
      replace = TRUE
    )

    # Retain every image of each selected specimen.
    selected_rows <- unlist(
      specimen_rows[selected_specimens],
      use.names = FALSE
    )

    sampled <- spider_test[selected_rows]

    # Evaluate all models on exactly the same sampled rows.
    rbindlist(
      lapply(seq_along(prediction_columns), function(i) {

        scores <- calculate_metrics(
          sampled$DRYMASS_MG,
          sampled[[prediction_columns[i]]]
        )

        data.table(
          REP = rep_id,
          MODEL = model_names[i],
          R2 = unname(scores["R2"]),
          MAE_mg = unname(scores["MAE_mg"]),
          RMSE_mg = unname(scores["RMSE_mg"]),
          CV_RMSE_percent = unname(scores["CV_RMSE_percent"])
        )
      })
    )
  })
)

bootstrap_long <- melt(
  bootstrap_results,
  id.vars = c("REP", "MODEL"),
  measure.vars = c("R2", "MAE_mg", "RMSE_mg", "CV_RMSE_percent"),
  variable.name = "METRIC",
  value.name = "VALUE"
)

stopifnot(is.numeric(bootstrap_long$VALUE))
bootstrap_long[, METRIC := as.character(METRIC)]

# Percentile 95% confidence intervals.
confidence_intervals <- bootstrap_long[
  ,
  {
    values <- VALUE[is.finite(VALUE)]

    .(
      lower_95 = if (length(values)) {
        as.numeric(quantile(values, 0.025))
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      upper_95 = if (length(values)) {
        as.numeric(quantile(values, 0.975))
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      valid_repetitions = length(values)
    )
  },
  by = .(MODEL, METRIC)
]

# Combine original estimates with bootstrap confidence intervals.
performance_summary <- merge(
  point_results,
  confidence_intervals,
  by = c("MODEL", "METRIC"),
  sort = FALSE
)

print(performance_summary)
```
